Policy and Governance Subcommittee
Order filed b y School Committee Member Lubold that in the interest of transparency, public
understanding, and engagement, all presentations, slide decks and other major presentation
materials included in School Committee Agenda Packets as a pre-read shall, as a matter of
standard practice: 1. Include a brief executive summary (no more than one page or one slide)
written in plain language that explains:
The presentation's main purpose
The key points or findings
Any actions being requested of the committee
Avoid or clearly limit technical jargon, and where specialized or legal terms are necessary,
provide a simple definition, "key terms" section in plain language.
Use clear headings and accessible formatting, including inclusive fonts "Arial, Helvetica,
Verdana, Calibri, or Open Sans" so that readers with disabilities and diverse language needs
can quickly understand what the topic is, why it matters, and what decisions or next steps are
being considered.
Ensure materials, to the greatest extent practicable, conform with Section 508 of the
Rehabilitation Act of 1973, as amended (29 U.S.C. 794d) and align with Web Content
Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 AA, or any successor standard. Order has been complied
with. No recommendations
That the School Committee Chair and Superintendent ensure that all communication to the
School Committee and public use the full word or term before an acronym can be used.
Rationale: To ensure all parties are clear that they are reading about the same term as
acronyms can stand for different terms. Order has been complied with. No recommendations

Parent and Community Engagement Committee
Motion: Ms. Lubold made a motion to acknowledge the purpose statement as amended, The
Parent and Caregiver Engagement Ad Hoc Committee is charged with reviewing and
strengthening the school's committee partnership with the DPAC, Special Education Parent
Advisory Council, and the English Learner Parent Advisory Council. The latter two as required
by Massachusetts law. And with identifying additional ways the committee can support
meaningful family engagement through policy and oversight. The committee will monitor
progress in collaboration with DPAC, SEPAC, and ELPAC, gather input from families, district
partners, and bring forward recommendations for policies, practices, accountability structures
that elevate family voice in planning, program development, and district improvement efforts
Motion : The Ad-Hoc committee's work is ongoing rather than time-limited, reflecting the
long-term nature of strengthening family engagement. The committee will operate on an initial
one-year timeline, with a formal check-in and reassessment of progress at the six-month mark.
Expected outcomes for this period include increased parent and caregiver involvement in
DPAC, CPAC, and ELPAC, greater visibility of the school committee's engagement efforts
within the community, stronger two-way communication channels between families and the
school committee. And regular reports from parent leaders of those committees to the full
school committee, modeled on the structure of existing student representative reports. The
school committee and parents in the district develop and encourage parent leaders to lead this
important work with their committees.
Motion : The matter of definition of meaningful parent and caregiver engagement that the
meaningful parent and caregiver engagement is ongoing... is an ongoing two-way relationship
between families and the school committee and the district, characterized by accessible
pathways for families to share feedback and experiences directly with the school committee
and the district beyond public comment and periodic surveys. Clear communication to parents
and caregivers about why their participation matters and how their input will be used, authentic
dialogue that goes beyond one-time or transactional interactions, and formal recognition of
families as essential partners in supporting student success and strengthening school
committee decision-making.

makes available a public discussion period for persons in the audience to address the
